name: Hina-chan no Himitsu
source:
One day, Hina visited my room, even though I warned her that I would do naughty things to her if she did.
At first, it was just a game, however, my feelings towards her changed little by little...

[Edited from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE046144.html]DL Site[/url]]
translation:
有一天，希娜来到我的房间，尽管我警告她如果她这样做我就会对她做一些顽皮的事情。
起初，这只是一个游戏，然而，我对她的感情却一点一点发生了变化……
